title: OJP • Operational overview
description: OJP server operations, SQL, Hikari/XA pools, query circuit breakers and optional cache. Prometheus scrapes supply job and instance. Missing or disabled instrumentation stays No data; zero-volume ratios are omitted. SQL metrics have no datasource label. Requires Grafana 10 or newer.

list.name: pool
list.label: Pool (optional)
list.definition: Hikari and XA pool names; All also works when pool metrics are disabled

list.name: datasource
list.label: Datasource (circuits/cache)
list.definition: Metric-derived circuit/cache/source-latency datasource names; not a SQL filter

panels.title: 01 • Operations at a glance — each instance stays visible
Scrape health
panels.description: Prometheus up per target, not application readiness. Down targets remain visible (0). Required selectors are independent of optional instrumentation.

panels.title: SQL executions / sec
panels.description: Recorded SQL executions, not all RPCs. sql_statement is summed per instance; these metrics have no datasource label.

panels.title: SQL p95
panels.description: Histogram quantile of recorded SQL execution time. No samples means no usable latency.

panels.title: RPC completions / sec
panels.description: Actual gRPC server duration histogram count from GrpcTelemetry's server interceptor. Includes all instrumented methods and gRPC statuses, not only SQL. gRPC status is not a count of SQL/application failures: SQL errors can be returned inside OK RPC responses. No data when gRPC metrics are disabled.

panels.title: RPC p95
panels.description: Instrumented server RPC duration in milliseconds, across methods on each instance. Separate from SQL execution time.

panels.title: RPC non-OK / sec
panels.description: Non-OK gRPC response statuses, not SQL/application failures returned inside OK RPC responses. Zero is derived only from an observed RPC family; missing RPC instrumentation remains No data.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance) (rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",rpc_grpc_status_code=~"[1-9][0-9]*"}[$__rate_interval])) or on (job, instance) (0 * sum by (job, instance) (rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Non-closed query circuits
panels.description: Current OPEN or HALF_OPEN circuits per instance (not the driver multinode circuit breaker). Exported closed circuits yield 0; no tracked circuits yields No data.

panels.title: Hikari • worst utilization
panels.description: Highest active/max ratio per instance, preserving the responsible pool name. Pools with max <= 0 are excluded. XA remains separate.

targets.expr: topk by (job, instance) (1, max by (job, instance, pool_name) (ojp_hikari_pool_connections_active_connections{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",pool_name=~"${pool:regex}"}) / (max by (job, instance, pool_name) (ojp_hikari_pool_connections_max_connections{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",pool_name=~"${pool:regex}"}) > 0))

panels.title: Hikari • worst waiters
panels.description: Largest current waiting-thread count per instance, retaining pool identity. This is a gauge, not a counter.

targets.expr: topk by (job, instance) (1, max by (job, instance, pool_name) (ojp_hikari_pool_connections_pending_threads{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",pool_name=~"${pool:regex}"}))

panels.title: XA • worst utilization
panels.description: Highest XA active/max ratio per instance. Unlimited/non-positive maximum values are omitted; never averaged with Hikari.

targets.expr: topk by (job, instance) (1, max by (job, instance, pool_name) (ojp_xa_pool_connections_active_connections{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",pool_name=~"${pool:regex}"}) / (max by (job, instance, pool_name) (ojp_xa_pool_connections_max_connections{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",pool_name=~"${pool:regex}"}) > 0))

panels.title: XA • worst waiters
panels.description: Largest current XA waiting-thread count per instance, preserving the responsible pool.

targets.expr: topk by (job, instance) (1, max by (job, instance, pool_name) (ojp_xa_pool_connections_pending_threads{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",pool_name=~"${pool:regex}"}))

panels.title: Hikari • active / idle / maximum
panels.description: Connections per job, instance and pool_name; capacity stays a separate series.

panels.title: Hikari • utilization
panels.description: Active / positive maximum per pool. 80% and 95% are visual guides, not universal alert thresholds.

targets.expr: max by (job, instance, pool_name) (ojp_hikari_pool_connections_active_connections{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",pool_name=~"${pool:regex}"}) / (max by (job, instance, pool_name) (ojp_hikari_pool_connections_max_connections{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",pool_name=~"${pool:regex}"}) > 0)

panels.title: Hikari • pending threads
panels.description: Current connection-acquisition waiters per pool. Not a rate.

panels.title: Hikari • acquisition p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Histogram acquisition time, milliseconds. Rate before aggregation; le, job, instance and pool_name retained. No interpolation over missing samples.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (job, instance, pool_name, le) (rate(ojp_hikari_pool_connections_acquisition_time_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",pool_name=~"${pool:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, instance, pool_name, le) (rate(ojp_hikari_pool_connections_acquisition_time_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",pool_name=~"${pool:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (job, instance, pool_name, le) (rate(ojp_hikari_pool_connections_acquisition_time_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",pool_name=~"${pool:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 03 • XA pools — separate instrumentation and capacity
XA • active / idle / maximum
panels.description: XA connection gauges per job, instance and pool_name. These are never merged with Hikari gauges.

panels.title: XA • utilization
panels.description: Active / positive maximum per XA pool. Unlimited maximum values are omitted honestly.

targets.expr: max by (job, instance, pool_name) (ojp_xa_pool_connections_active_connections{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",pool_name=~"${pool:regex}"}) / (max by (job, instance, pool_name) (ojp_xa_pool_connections_max_connections{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",pool_name=~"${pool:regex}"}) > 0)

panels.title: XA • pending threads
panels.description: Current connection-acquisition waiters per XA pool. Gauge, not a rate.

panels.title: XA • acquisition p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: XA histogram acquisition times in milliseconds. Quantiles computed independently per instance and pool.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (job, instance, pool_name, le) (rate(ojp_xa_pool_connections_acquisition_time_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",pool_name=~"${pool:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, instance, pool_name, le) (rate(ojp_xa_pool_connections_acquisition_time_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",pool_name=~"${pool:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (job, instance, pool_name, le) (rate(ojp_xa_pool_connections_acquisition_time_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",pool_name=~"${pool:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 04 • SQL execution — instance-scoped, no datasource label
SQL • throughput and slow throughput
panels.description: Execution counters summed after rate per instance. Slow is OJP's learned relative classification, not an absolute latency SLA. A missing slow counter is not fabricated as zero.

panels.title: SQL • relative slow ratio
panels.description: Slow execution rate / positive execution rate per instance. Missing counters and zero-volume intervals remain gaps. Classification compares learned query averages, not a fixed latency threshold.

panels.title: SQL • p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Distribution across sql_statement on each instance, in milliseconds. Histogram quantiles are bucket estimates; statement identities appear only in the bounded drill-down.

panels.title: SQL • weighted mean
panels.description: Sum of execution time / positive count over the rate interval. Weighted by execution volume, not the average of per-statement means.

panels.title: 05 • SQL drill-down — top 10 over the selected time range (sensitive SQL labels)
Top SQL • total execution time
panels.description: Top 10 statement/instance combinations by accumulated execution time over $__range. Concurrent execution time can exceed wall time. Raw SQL labels may contain sensitive data; restrict dashboard access.

panels.title: Top SQL • mean latency
panels.description: Top 10 by mean execution latency over $__range, excluding statements with zero executions. Low-volume statements can rank highly; compare the execution-count table.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (job, instance, sql_statement) (increase(ojp_sql_execution_time_milliseconds_sum{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__range])) / (sum by (job, instance, sql_statement) (increase(ojp_sql_execution_time_milliseconds_count{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__range])) > 0))

panels.title: Top SQL • execution count
panels.description: Top 10 statement/instance combinations by execution-counter increase over $__range. Prometheus extrapolation may produce fractional counts.

panels.title: 06 • Detailed query circuit breakers — expand for query hashes
Query circuit • state
panels.description: 0 CLOSED, 1 OPEN, 2 HALF_OPEN, keyed by datasource and query_hash. High-cardinality detail: narrow instance/datasource selections before expanding. Removed states disappear; gaps are not interpreted as CLOSED. Distinct from JDBC driver failover circuits.

panels.title: Query circuit • trips and blocked calls
panels.description: Counter rates per instance and datasource. A trip means opening due to failure conditions; blocked calls never reached SQL execution. Absent counters stay absent.

panels.title: Query circuit • completed OPEN duration p95
panels.description: Seconds spent OPEN before leaving that state. Recorded only when an OPEN interval ends; this is not the current age of a still-open circuit.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, instance, datasource, le) (rate(ojp_circuit_breaker_open_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",datasource=~"${datasource:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 07 • Optional query cache — volume-weighted effectiveness and source latency
Cache • hit and miss throughput
panels.description: Sum counter rates across SQL labels, preserving instance and datasource. Cache-disabled deployments remain No data.

panels.title: Cache • volume-weighted hit ratio
panels.description: Hit rate / positive combined hit+miss rate, summed across SQL labels before division. Not an average of per-SQL percentages. A missing hit or miss family leaves a gap rather than assuming zero.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, datasource) (rate(ojp_cache_hits_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",datasource=~"${datasource:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) / ((sum by (job, instance, datasource) (rate(ojp_cache_hits_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",datasource=~"${datasource:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (job, instance, datasource) (rate(ojp_cache_misses_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",datasource=~"${datasource:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0)

panels.title: Cache • entry occupancy
panels.description: Current entries per instance and datasource. No exported capacity exists, so this is not a fullness percentage.

panels.title: Cache • byte occupancy
panels.description: Estimated current cached result bytes per instance and datasource; not process memory.

panels.title: Cache • churn and rejections
panels.description: Counter rates summed over reason/table labels, retaining instance and datasource. Rejections mean results too large for caching.

panels.title: Query source • p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Optional cache instrumentation: milliseconds by source=cache or database, instance and datasource. Compare within each source; do not combine the distributions.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (job, instance, datasource, source, le) (rate(ojp_query_execution_time_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",datasource=~"${datasource:regex}",source=~"cache|database"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, instance, datasource, source, le) (rate(ojp_query_execution_time_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",datasource=~"${datasource:regex}",source=~"cache|database"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (job, instance, datasource, source, le) (rate(ojp_query_execution_time_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",datasource=~"${datasource:regex}",source=~"cache|database"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 08 • RPC / XA diagnostics — method, status and failure events
RPC • method / status throughput
panels.description: Completed server RPC rate by service, method and gRPC status, preserving each instance. Status 0 is OK; SQL/application exceptions may still be encoded in OK responses.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, rpc_service, rpc_method, rpc_grpc_status_code) (rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: RPC • non-OK by method / status
panels.description: Only recorded nonzero gRPC statuses. An absent non-OK family stays absent in this drill-down; the landing indicator derives zero only from observed RPC metrics. Not a complete SQL/application error count.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, rpc_service, rpc_method, rpc_grpc_status_code) (rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",rpc_grpc_status_code=~"[1-9][0-9]*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: XA • exhaustion, validation failures and leaks
panels.description: Actual XA event counter rates per instance and pool. Exhaustion means borrowing timed out. These are not inferred from pending threads or opened/destroyed lifecycle gauges. Missing event families remain No data.
